why: Both cover post-loss responses to a work's state, and the same item can save a record while also reporting what happened.

why.T3-039: The item is about moving/yielding the logo's spot when neighbouring groups need the space, with an agreement to stay inside its own logo, rather than a fresh border settlement or a post-attack relocation.

why.T3-009: The concepts mark the completed logo as achieved and praise the group's result, not just report progress or credit individuals.

why.T3-002: The concepts rally people to help place and locate the mark next to Satania, which is a call for hands to a chosen placement.

why.T3-028: The item is arranged around bot/script help for rebuilding the logo, with image and grid requirements, rather than a general request to another room for hands.

why.T3-005: The concepts raise an alarm that the logo is being overrun and describe defending it against old scripts, which is an attack-and-defence situation.

why.T3-105: The item centers on saving and keeping screenshots of the work after loss, including debate over whether a screenshot is just as good.
why.T3-029: Several concepts voice grief and loss at the logo being gone or almost entirely gone.
why.T3-073: Other concepts plainly report what happened to the work, such as the lock, elimination, retracted update, and botted removal.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-105 only reaches keeping a record and does not carry the explicit grief and loss voiced at the logo's disappearance.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0650831, C0815464, C1110363, and C1217562 voice loss or grief for the gone or nearly gone logo.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-029 if forced; lose the mourning and loss language that is distinct from saving a screenshot.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-105 records the work as it stood but does not carry the plain reports of what happened to it once lost.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0072684, C0226725, C1096296, and C0781114 report the work's fate: botted out, locked, eliminated, or retracted as gone.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-073 if forced; lose the neutral reporting of the loss and aftermath.

why.T3-028: Most concepts request, share, teach, circulate, or troubleshoot scripts and bots for rebuilding the logo.
why.T3-027: A distinct set of concepts argues or acts on whether scripts are fair: refusing scripts, defending hand-built work, and urging scripts because everyone uses them.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-028 reaches scripts being run and shared, but not the dispute over whether scripts are fair or the refusals to use them.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0396703, C1010951, C1126724, C0917445, C1402500, C0072529, and C1509277 argue or act on the fairness of scripts and hand-built work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-027 if forced; lose the explicit fairness dispute and refusals that accompany the script use.

why.T3-009: The concepts mark the completed logo as achieved and praise the group's result, not just report progress or credit individuals.

why.T3-139: The item asks Quebec-side participants to leave the AFF dots alone or spare the logo as their flags expand.
why.T3-083: A distinct part of the item treats the language gap as the problem in negotiating with Quebec: recruiting a French speaker, lacking enough French, and using Google Translate.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-139 carries the request to spare the dots but does not carry the translation and language-barrier work needed to make that request.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0361745, C0112201, and C0828170 make the language gap the practical problem in negotiating with Quebec.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-083 if forced; lose the language-gap negotiation that shapes how the request is made.

why.T3-015: The concepts redirect and centralise r/place updates into existing or stickied threads, with warnings that new posts may be deleted, which is megathread routing.

why.T3-009: The concepts announce the logo as complete and praise or take pride in the finished work.

why.T3-149: The item tries to make and sends a truce to the nearby box builders to forestall conflict over space.
why.T3-150: It then claims an alliance with r/edBoxes that will keep an eye out for the logo, which is a standing defensive alliance.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-149 reaches ending or forestalling a fight by truce but not the standing alliance to watch out for the logo.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1206296 describes making an alliance with r/edBoxes so they keep an eye out for the logo.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-150 if forced; lose the alliance/protection outcome that goes beyond the truce.

why.T3-002: The item rallies members to a last-minute Air For Free logo and calls for help building it, with the colour/border details serving that call.

why.T3-073: The surviving concepts are r/place updates reporting on the work's state; with bodies deleted, the closest gate is reporting how the work fared rather than a more specific action.
